messages:
Rae (PM): quick thought — run a 2-week DP experiment to improve onboarding-to-first-success. keep it surgical: three touchpoints + one auth detector. goal: 30% lift in first-success within 7 days.
Diego (Eng): ok. define "first-success" so we can instrument it across hosted/dedicated/private.
Rae (PM): hosted: API call that returns schema-valid JSON for our probe. dedicated/private: health + probe pass. segment private out of primary cohort.
Tara (CS): propose probe intent that covers common user flows (completion + structured fields). avoid brittle exact-match checks.
Cal (SE): I'll help craft 3 probe queries that simulate typical partner workloads (chat, structured generation, embed+rank).
Nina (DevEx): plan: Quickstart button in Console (runs sample request), a checklist modal, and an optional 1Q survey after success. Also add language-specific snippets on variant.
Li (Data): events needed: dp_signup, quickstart_clicked, auth_failed, probe_passed, survey_score. plus variant id and dp_tag.
Diego (Eng): estimate: events + quickstart + checklist modal = 2.5 dev-days. auth detection + immediate nudge routing = 1 day. feature-flagged.
Rae (PM): variants: A = control, B = personalized snippet (by stack), C = immediate auth-adaptive nudge. randomize on signup.
Tara (CS): we'll include an invite template that calls out the quickstart and optional SE session. clear ask = 10–15 minutes.
Nina (DevEx): I can deliver the quickstart + checklist in 3 business days and wire the one-question survey.
Li (Data): targets: primary = % probe_passed within 7 days; secondary = median time-to-success, survey mean, auth-related ticket rate. target +30% primary, -30% auth tickets.
Rae (PM): launch gates: either statistically significant uplift (p<0.05) on primary or auth tickets drop >=40% and time-to-success improves. also no negative cost/latency regression.
Diego (Eng): we'll expose a kill-switch for the FF and monitor error rates.
LabBot: experiment "dp_onboard_activation_era1" created, CI checks green.
Rae (PM): actions: Diego -> event schema + FF by EOD; Nina -> quickstart + modal; Li -> analysis spec; Cal -> probe queries; Tara -> invite copy. preflight Fri 10:00am.
Nina (DevEx): I'll post the preflight checklist 24h before.
Cal (SE): happy to take earliest DP who volunteers for the pilot and help run the session.
Rae (PM): thanks all. aim to keep the experiment minimal and measurable. :rocket:
